<subject>Re: Need to pay Hôpital de Lyon bill by COB Tues 27/11.    NOTICE OF Hôpital de Lyon SERVICE AGREEMENT BREACH - November 18th PAYMENT TO Hôpital de Lyon IS OVERDUE</subject>
<body>
Alain -- My understanding was that Lumière Santé had satisfied Hôpital de Lyon's credit requirements last week; however, below is a notice that the bill has not been paid and Lumière Santé will not be able to participate in Hôpital de Lyon's medical services if the bill is not paid by 27/11 COB.
 
Please let us know if Médical Services needs to call Hôpital de Lyon to try to discuss this.  Jacqueline 
Jacqueline Guilbert
Executive Assistant
Lumière Santé SAS
6, rue de la République
69001 Lyon
Tél : 04 72 32 15 07
</body>
<quoted>
-----Original Message----- 
From: Cousin, Richard 
Sent: Wed 19/11/2025 9:20 
To: Guilbert, Jacqueline; Robin, Philippe 
Cc: Boulay, Hugues; Laine, Emmanuel 
Subject: FW: Santé Médicale AGREEMENT BREACH - November 18th PAYMENT TO Hôpital de Lyon IS OVERDUE



FYI 

-----Original Message----- 
From: d992@pexcorcorp.com [<mailto:d992@pexcorcorp.com>] 
Sent: Tuesday, 18/11/2025 20:43 
To: helene.pruvost@lumieresante.fr; victor.hoarau@lumieresante.fr 
Cc: d742@sollumlabs.com; l184@sollumlabs.com 
Subject: Santé Médicale AGREEMENT BREACH - November 18th 
PAYMENT TO Hôpital de Lyon IS OVERDUE 
Importance: High 


> This is your formal notice that Hôpital de Lyon now considers your company in breach of 
> the Hôpital de Lyon Service Agreement for non-payment of your November 5, 2025 Hôpital de Lyon 
> invoice by 13:00 today. In accordance with the current provisions of Section 
> 15.1.3 of Hôpital de Lyon's Service Agreement, you have three business days to rectify 
> this breach by making full payment to Hôpital de Lyon. If this breach is not rectified by 
> the end of Hôpital de Lyon's business day on Tuesday, 26/11/2025, Hôpital de Lyon will declare 
> your company in default and terminate your rights to participate at Hôpital de Lyon 
> committee meetings, to transact business in Hôpital de Lyon's medical services, and to receive 
> medical care from Hôpital de Lyon. Additionally, all Hôpital de Lyon Members will receive a 
> list tomorrow of companies that did not pay their invoice for October activity 
> on the due date. 
> 
> If you have any questions regarding this notice or the amount your company 
> owes to Hôpital de Lyon, please contact Margot Ferreira at +33 4 19 32 69 07 or Olivie Le Roux at 
> +33 4 71 47 75 05. 
> 
> Suzanne Daugherty 
> Controller 
</quoted>
